text: YouTuber CarryMinati, whose real name is Ajey Nagar, is set to make his Bollywood debut with Ajay Devgn and Amitabh Bachchan starrer 'MayDay'. "I agreed to be...part of this film because I'd to essay my own character (CarryMinati)," he said. "I'm hoping I get to learn a thing or two about acting from Amitabh Bachchan and Ajay Devgn," he added.
